methodologyNote: No font file was downloaded from alfont.com during this audit. alfont.com displays zero license, copyright, designer, or version metadata on its homepage or on every individual font page checked (sampled across all categories below) -- only a generic 'free download' claim, which this audit does not treat as evidence of a legal license, per explicit instruction. Because downloading any file requires the user's explicit per-file permission, and because the license gate had not yet been cleared for any alfont-hosted candidate, no files were fetched into a temporary audit directory this pass. Consequently the fontTools technical audit, HarfBuzz shaping test, and Tashkeel test (Phase 10A points 3, 7, 8) were NOT performed on any alfont-hosted file -- 'technicalAudit', 'harfbuzzShaping', and 'tashkeelAudit' below are 'not_performed' for every entry, not 'passed'. 'calligraphicClass' is marked 'provisional' where based only on the family's known public identity/reputation rather than direct visual/technical inspection of the actual alfont-hosted file.

families.designer: King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST), Saudi Arabia
families.licenseStatus: REQUIRES ATTRIBUTION / license-compatibility review — GPLv2 per Fedora's own package metadata (not OFL). GPLv2 on a font can have redistribution implications for anything statically linked/embedded with it (the classic 'GPL font exception' concern for GPL fonts that lack that exception); before bundling, confirm whether the KACST fonts carry a font exception and whether GPLv2 is compatible with how this project distributes its own bundle.
families.redistributionAllowed: likely yes under GPLv2 terms, but with copyleft implications not present in the project's other OFL-licensed fonts — needs explicit legal comparison before bundling, not assumed equivalent to the OFL fonts already in this project
families.webEmbeddingAllowed: likely yes (a WOFF/TTF served as-is, unmodified, is a common real-world use of these fonts), but not independently confirmed for THIS project's exact distribution model
families.canDownload: yes, from the authoritative distro packages; NOT verified for alfont's 'Kacst Farsi' copy specifically, which was not confirmed to be byte-identical to an official KACST release
families.canRedistribute: GPLv2 permits redistribution; verify compatibility with this project's own licensing before use
families.canBundleInRepo: WEB EMBEDDING NOT VERIFIED for this project specifically — GPLv2 nuance needs resolving first
families.canServeAsWebfont: WEB EMBEDDING NOT VERIFIED — same reason
families.canModifySubset: GPLv2 permits modification; subsetting a GPL font raises the same font-exception question
families.note: A real, traceable, non-alfont-original font family with a real government/institutional designer — much better provenance than most of the site's other listings — but GPLv2 (not OFL) means it needs its own explicit license review, not a rubber-stamp SAFE classification just because it's 'free and open source.'
families.calligraphicClass: B (provisional — a solid general Arabic display family; not marketed or known as a traditional calligraphic style)
